opportunities.title: Premium Food Box Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a designer who can transform a simple food‐grade carton into packaging that instantly reads premium and high-end. The product is in the food & drink space, so the artwork must balance appetite appeal with an upscale presence that will stand out both on a retail shelf and in e-commerce imagery. You’ll start from the box dieline (I can supply the rough dimensions or we can refine them together) and develop a complete visual system—color palette, typography, graphic elements, and any finishing suggestions such as foil, soft-touch varnish, or embossing. I’m keen to keep the look elegant and modern rather than loud; think clean lines, confident use of space, and tasteful hierarchy. Brand assets, any mandatory claims, and copy will be provided once we kick off, but your eye for sophisticated detail is what will make the pack sing. Deliverables • Print-ready artwork on the final dieline (CMYK, 300 dpi, with bleed and cutter guides) • Two to three high-quality 3D mock-ups for presentation and online use • Editable source file (AI preferred) with linked fonts and images Acceptance Criteria • Artwork passes a printer’s pre-flight check without modifications • Mock-ups accurately reflect final colors and finishing effects • All text remains editable and fonts are either outlined or provided If you’ve crafted luxury packaging for food or beverages before, especially boxes or cartons, I’d love to see those examples. Let’s give this product the refined shelf presence it deserves.

opportunities.title: Estrategia Contenido y Crecimiento para Proyecto de Divulgación His...
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista en estrategia de contenido y crecimiento para un proyecto de divulgación histórica sobre México. El objetivo es expandir la presencia y el alcance del contenido en plataformas clave como Instagram, TikTok, Facebook y YouTube, manteniendo siempre el rigor histórico de las fuentes y un tono cercano y divertido. El profesional deberá ofrecer asesoría experta para: - Definir los tipos de contenido y formatos más adecuados para cada red social. - Desarrollar estrategias para adaptar y reutilizar videos existentes y futuros. - Fortalecer la marca personal del proyecto en todas las plataformas. - Establecer los pasos y métodos para monetizar el proyecto de manera efectiva. Como entregable inicial, se requiere un diagnóstico exhaustivo de las redes sociales actuales del proyecto y una propuesta de estrategia detallada. Esta propuesta debe incluir prioridades claras, sugerencias de formatos, una frecuencia de publicación recomendada y métricas clave para evaluar el progreso y el éxito de la estrategia. Adicionalmente, se valora la capacidad de ofrecer servicios de edición de video, ya sea como parte integral de la propuesta o cotizados por separado. Es fundamental que el enfoque del especialista no incluya la compra de seguidores ni promesas de viralidad o ingresos garantizados, sino una estrategia orgánica y sostenible. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Pocas publicaciones por semana o marca en crecimiento

opportunities.title: Gestión de Ventas WhatsApp
opportunities.description: Necesito a alguien que tome el control diario de mi bandeja de WhatsApp Business. El objetivo es responder de forma ágil todas las consultas entrantes y convertirlas en ventas de nuestros productos físicos. Qué espero de tu parte: • Leer y contestar mensajes de potenciales clientes con un tono cercano y profesional. • Guiar la conversación hasta el cierre de la venta: enviar información clave, resolver objeciones, ofrecer medios de pago y confirmar el pedido. • Registrar cada interacción en nuestro pequeño CRM (Google Sheets) para que el inventario y la logística se mantengan al día. • Detectar preguntas frecuentes y proponer respuestas rápidas o plantillas que optimicen el tiempo de atención. Trabajo 100 % remoto. Requiero disponibilidad comprobable durante el horario comercial de mi país y experiencia previa atendiendo ventas por WhatsApp. Si ya has usado herramientas como etiquetas, mensajes automáticos o catálogos dentro de WhatsApp Business, menciónalo: suma muchos puntos.

opportunities.title: Infinity Pool & Spa Hydraulic Engineering
opportunities.description: Swimming Pool & Spa Hydraulic Design Project Description We are looking for an experienced hydraulic engineer to design a complete hydraulic system for a residential swimming pool and spa. The project requires detailed hydraulic calculations, proper pipe and pump sizing, equipment selection, and complete plumbing schematics. We need an engineer with practical experience in swimming pool hydraulic systems, not just someone who can produce CAD drawings. Scope of Work 1. Hydraulic Engineering Calculate required circulation flow rates for the swimming pool and spa. Perform total dynamic head (TDH) and pipe friction-loss calculations. Determine appropriate suction and return pipe sizes. Calculate flow requirements for spa jets and water features. Design infinity-edge circulation systems. Verify system performance using pump performance curves. 2. Equipment Sizing Select appropriate circulation pumps and variable-speed pumps. Size pool filters and associated equipment. Determine spa jet pump requirements. Calculate required surge tank or catch basin capacity, if applicable. Specify necessary valves, fittings, and hydraulic components. 3. Hydraulic Drawings Complete swimming pool and spa hydraulic schematic. Plumbing layout with pipe sizes and flow directions. Pump, filter, heater, and valve connections. Equipment room plumbing arrangement and size needed. Clearly identified operating modes for pool, spa, and water features. Required Deliverables Complete hydraulic design calculations in Excel or PDF. Pump selection with manufacturer performance curves. Pipe sizing and friction-loss calculation report. Pool and spa hydraulic schematic (PDF and DWG). Equipment schedule with specifications. Final hydraulic design documentation suitable for construction coordination. Required Experience Proven swimming pool and spa hydraulic engineering experience. Strong understanding of pump curves, TDH, pipe sizing, and flow balancing. Experience designing spa jet systems and infinity-edge pools. Proficiency in AutoCAD and hydraulic calculation methods. When Submitting Your Proposal Please provide: Examples of similar completed pool and spa projects. Samples of hydraulic calculations and plumbing schematics. Your fixed price for the complete project. Estimated delivery time. Confirmation that all hydraulic calculations and editable CAD drawings are included. Important: This is a one-time engineering design project. We require a complete hydraulic design supported by engineering calculations, not just a basic plumbing layout. If the proposal is submitted by AI will be automatic rejected, you must read the whole project description and understand the requirement.

Before bidding, please confirm: * Have you successfully handled rejected Meta Business Verification cases? * Can you arrange genuine UK business telephone documentation if required? * Can you manage the complete project? * What is your total fixed price and expected timeline? opportunities.title: Odoo ERP Implementation Specialist / Official Odoo Partner - Immediate Start Required
opportunities.description: Odoo ERP Implementation Specialist / Official Odoo Partner – Long-Term Collaboration We are a Germany-based technology company currently developing and launching two innovative software products: Zukunftsschmiede and ErxlebenAI. Zukunftsschmiede is a digital learning and development platform combining interactive education, AI-powered coaching, gamification, and subscription-based services. ErxlebenAI is an enterprise AI platform providing secure, customizable AI solutions for businesses through various subscription-based products and services. We have decided to implement Odoo as our central ERP system to manage and streamline our business operations. For this project, we are looking for an experienced Odoo specialist, preferably an official Odoo Partner or certified consultant, who can take responsibility for the initial implementation and support us with the ongoing development of the system. This is not a one-time project. We are looking for a reliable long-term partner who can help us build a scalable ERP environment that grows alongside our business. Our Approach We do not intend to implement every Odoo module immediately. Instead, we want to establish a solid technical foundation and gradually introduce additional modules, integrations, and automated workflows as our business requirements evolve. We are looking for someone who can advise us on the right architecture, recommend suitable Odoo modules, and independently handle their configuration and implementation. Initial Responsibilities The first phase will focus on analyzing our requirements, recommending the appropriate Odoo architecture, and setting up the ERP environment. This includes the installation and configuration of Odoo, defining the overall system structure, setting up users and permissions, and preparing the environment for future expansion. We also expect guidance on the most suitable Odoo version, hosting solution, and deployment model. Odoo Modules We plan to introduce various Odoo modules over time, including CRM, customer management, sales, quotations, subscription management, recurring billing, invoicing, customer support, reporting, and workflow automation. The exact modules and their implementation order will be determined together based on our operational priorities. Integrations An important part of the project will be connecting Odoo with our existing and future software infrastructure. We are particularly interested in integrating our own SaaS platforms, Zukunftsschmiede and ErxlebenAI, as well as our Shopify-based e-commerce environment. API integrations, automated workflows, and reliable synchronization of relevant customer, subscription, and billing data will play an important role. German Business Requirements Since our companies operate in Germany, experience with German business processes would be highly beneficial. Knowledge of German invoicing requirements, VAT, accounting workflows, GDPR, and DATEV integrations would be a significant advantage. Long-Term Collaboration Once the initial setup is completed, we intend to continuously expand the system. Future projects will include implementing additional Odoo modules, developing new integrations, improving existing workflows, introducing automation, and providing ongoing technical support. We are interested in establishing a lasting professional relationship rather than hiring different freelancers for individual tasks. Requirements We expect extensive practical experience with Odoo ERP, preferably including several complete implementations. Strong knowledge of Odoo architecture, module configuration, API integrations, and business process automation is essential. Experience with SaaS businesses, subscription-based business models, Shopify integrations, and multi-company ERP environments would be particularly valuable. Official Odoo Partner status or relevant Odoo certifications are strongly preferred. We value independent working methods structured project execution reliable communication ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions Collaboration Budget We would like to begin with an initial assessment basic system setup clear implementation roadmap The project will then continue in individual phases clearly defined milestones budgets We are open fixed-price agreements individual implementation phases hourly arrangements ongoing development support Our priority finding technically competent reliable partner deliver high-quality work support long-term growth Application When submitting your proposal please tell us whether you official Odoo Partner certified consultant how many complete Odoo implementations you delivered whether you experience SaaS companies recurring subscription models appreciate information about experience Shopify DATEV German accounting requirements API integrations Please share examples comparable projects explain approach modular long-term Odoo implementation provide hourly rate current availability We looking forward finding dedicated Odoo implementation partner help establish continuously develop reliable scalable ERP infrastructure growing software business.

opportunities.title: Luxury Full-Home Interior Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to transform my entire home into a cohesive, luxury-driven space that feels refined yet livable. The brief covers every zone—living and dining areas, all bedrooms with their adjoining bathrooms, plus the kitchen and supporting storage rooms—so the final result must flow seamlessly from one room to the next while still letting each space shine on its own. The aesthetic I’m after is unapologetically elegant: rich textures, timeless lines, sophisticated lighting, and a polished palette that conveys comfort without sacrificing grandeur. Think boutique-hotel quality with a personal twist. Here’s what I need from you: • Detailed space-planning layouts that maximise natural movement and function • Mood boards capturing colour schemes, materials, and key inspiration images for each room • 3D visualisations or photorealistic renders showing day and evening lighting scenarios • A complete FF&E schedule (furniture, fixtures, equipment) including sourcing links or local vendor suggestions • Finish, fabric, and paint specifications consolidated into a clear presentation package • Installation or styling guidelines I can hand straight to my contractor Please base your work on standard tools like AutoCAD or Revit for plans and SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar for renders—whatever you’re most comfortable with as long as final files are editable. I’ll supply existing floor plans, measurements, and reference photos once we start, and I’m happy to collaborate over regular check-ins to fine-tune decisions. Present one unified concept first; after feedback, refine it into fully detailed documents ready for execution. If this sounds like your calibre of project, let’s create something truly stunning together.

opportunities.description: I’m producing a short, animated explainer to launch a new health-equity initiative and need an AI-generated cartoon spokesperson to carry the message. The character must look friendly and professional, yet still feel warm, community-focused, youthful, and fun. The narration should resonate with patients, community members, healthcare workers, organizations, and doctors alike. • A tone that invites viewers to learn more, share the message, and take part in our upcoming community health programs. I’ll send you the project overview and key talking points as soon as we start. If this first video captures the spirit of the initiative, I’ll commission additional episodes to accompany the rest of my articles, so long-term collaboration is definitely on the table. Two thumbnail stills for social sharing. 4. make sure the character’s name is HELI I’m ready to move quickly—show me your portfolio of similar AI or cartoon explainer work and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Discord szerver építés-menedzsment
opportunities.description: Európai uniós finanszírozású, zöldség-gyümölcs fogyasztást népszerűsítő kampányunkhoz Discord-specialistát keresek. Feladatod két fő részre oszlik. 1. Szerver felépítése – Strukturált kategóriák és csatornák kialakítása a 10–18, illetve a 18–39 éves célcsoportoknak. – Moderációs és engagement botok (pl. MEE6, Carl-bot) beállítása, alap jogosultság- és biztonsági rendszer megtervezése. – Rollek és onboarding folyamat automatizálása, hogy a frissen érkezők azonnal a megfelelő korosztály-szobába kerüljenek. 2. Folyamatos tartalommenedzsment (heti 5 óra) – Heti naptár szerint egészséges étkezési tippek és receptek közzététele, külön kiemelve a 26–35 éveseknek szánt ötleteket. – Közösségépítő mini-kihívások, szavazások, voice események szervezése a fiatalabb réteg aktivizálásához. – Analitika figyelése, aktivitás-riport készítése, javaslatok a csatornastruktúra vagy tartalom finomhangolására. Teljesen remote munkavégzés, rugalmas beosztásban. Számítok magabiztos Discord-kezelési tapasztalatra, bot-beállítási rutira, kreatív közösségépítő ötletekre és korrekt írásbeli magyar kommunikációra. Kizárólag magyarul beszélő kollégát keresünk, mert a program megvalósításának nyelve magyar.

opportunities.title: Presales SPOC for DPDP Platform
opportunities.description: Hiring: Freelance Presales SPOC – DPDP Consent Management Platform Product: Privafocus – DPDP Consent Management Platform Engagement: Freelance / Part-Time / Contract Work Mode: Remote Experience: 4–8 years in technical consulting, solution architecture, SaaS product development, or technical pre-sales. About the Role We are looking for a technically proficient freelance resource to act as the Presales Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Privafocus, a consent management platform designed to support organisations in addressing India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, and applicable rules. The resource will work closely with the sales, product, and development teams to conduct technical product demonstrations, explain solution architecture, address customer technical queries, validate integration requirements, and support proof-of-concept (POC) implementations. Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Product Demonstrations - Conduct end-to-end technical demonstrations of the Privafocus platform. - Demonstrate consent collection, purpose and notice management, consent withdrawal, cookie consent, and audit trails. - Explain data principal rights, grievance management, compliance dashboards, and reporting workflows. - Demonstrate technical workflows and integration scenarios based on customer requirements. 2. Technical Solution Consulting - Understand customer IT environments and translate business requirements into technical solutions. - Explain product architecture, deployment options, APIs, SDKs, databases, and integration capabilities. - Support discussions on cloud infrastructure, data security, access controls, authentication, and multi-tenancy. - Identify technical gaps and recommend suitable implementation approaches. 3. API & Integration Support - Explain REST APIs, API authentication, webhooks, and integration workflows. - Support integration discussions involving websites, enterprise applications, CRM, ServiceNow, and identity providers. - Provide technical guidance for cookie consent, email consent, WhatsApp consent, and database integrations. - Coordinate with developers to validate integration feasibility and resolve technical queries. 4. DPDP Technical Compliance - Understand the technical requirements associated with DPDP consent management. - Explain consent lifecycle management, purpose-specific consent, notice versioning, consent withdrawal, and evidence logging. - Support discussions on auditability, role-based access control, data retention, and privacy workflows. - Map customer requirements to existing platform capabilities and identify development gaps. 5. POC & Technical Evaluation - Support customer proof-of-concept implementations and technical evaluations. - Prepare technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires, and solution assessments. - Document customer requirements, integration dependencies, and technical assumptions. - Coordinate with the development team to resolve issues and validate proposed solutions. 6. Product & Development Coordination - Act as the presales SPOC between customers' sales teams and our internal product management/engineering teams. - Translate technical requirements into user stories and functional specifications when required. - Review new features and validate them against agreed requirements. - Maintain technical documentation such as architecture diagrams or API documentation guides.

opportunities.title: DPDP Consent Platform Technical Project Lead
opportunities.description: Hiring: Freelance Project Manager & Technical Expert – DPDP Consent Management Platform Engagement Type: Freelance / Contract Project: DPDP Compliance & Consent Management SaaS Platform Location: Remote Experience: 5+ years preferred in product development, project management, or privacy technology Project Overview We are developing Privafocus, a consent management platform designed to help organisations comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. We are looking for an experienced freelance Project Manager with strong technical expertise in consent management, privacy compliance, and SaaS product development. The resource should be capable of providing technical guidance, conducting product demonstrations, validating product functionality, and supporting our development team in building an enterprise-ready solution. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Demonstration & Technical Expertise - Conduct detailed demonstrations of consent management and privacy compliance platforms. - Explain end-to-end consent management workflows, including consent collection, recording, withdrawal, and audit trails. - Demonstrate DPDP compliance functionalities such as notices, purposes, data principal rights, grievance management, and privacy dashboards. - Explain real-world implementation scenarios and enterprise use cases. 2. Project Management & Product Development - Work closely with our development team to define product requirements and functional specifications. - Prepare user stories, acceptance criteria, product workflows, and development roadmaps. - Support sprint planning, task prioritisation, and milestone tracking. - Review developed features and validate them against business and compliance requirements. - Identify product gaps and recommend practical solutions. 3. Technical Architecture & Integration - Provide guidance on consent management platform architecture and SaaS product development. - Advise on APIs, SDKs, database integrations, website integrations, and third-party systems. - Support integration planning for cookie consent, email consent, WhatsApp consent, and enterprise applications. - Guide implementation of role-based access control, audit logging, consent evidence, and multi-tenant architecture. 4. DPDP Compliance Expertise - Understand the DPDP Act, 2023, and applicable rules and implementation requirements. - Map legal and compliance requirements to product features and technical controls. - Advise on consent notices, specific purposes, consent records, withdrawal mechanisms, and demonstrable compliance evidence. - Help ensure that product functionality aligns with applicable legal requirements. 5. Product Review & Knowledge Transfer - Conduct periodic product demonstrations and technical review sessions. - Review existing modules and identify functional or architectural gaps. - Provide actionable recommendations and implementation guidance. - Prepare technical documentation and support knowledge transfer to the internal team. Required Skills & Experience - Experience in consent management platforms, privacy technology, or data protection solutions. - Strong understanding of DPDP Act requirements and consent lifecycle management. - Experience in SaaS product development and technical project management. - Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, system integrations, and cloud-based architectures. - Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications. - Experience with platforms such as OneTrust, TrustArc, Cookiebot, Didomi, or similar solutions is preferred. - Excellent communication and demonstration skills. Expected Deliverables 1. Initial product assessment and gap analysis. 2. Detailed demonstration of consent management workflows and industry best practices. 3. Product requirements and functional specifications. 4. Technical architecture and integration recommendations. 5. Development roadmap with prioritised features and milestones. 6. Periodic product reviews and technical guidance. 7. Documentation and knowledge transfer to the development team. Engagement Model The engagement can begin with an initial paid discovery and demonstration phase, followed by ongoing part-time or milestone-based support, depending on project requirements. Interested freelancers should share: - Relevant experience in consent management or privacy compliance products. - Examples of similar products or implementations they have worked on. - Their proposed approach to product assessment and technical guidance. - Availability, hourly rate, or fixed-price proposal. Important: We are looking for a hands-on professional who can demonstrate real product workflows, provide practical technical expertise, and guide our development team—not just someone who offers theoretical consulting. To Apply: Please share your profile, relevant project experience, and proposed engagement model.

The resource should be capable of providing technical guidance, conducting product demonstrations, validating product functionality, and supporting our development team in building an enterprise-ready solution. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Demonstration & Technical Expertise - Conduct detailed demonstrations of consent management and privacy compliance platforms. - Explain end-to-end consent management workflows, including consent collection, recording, withdrawal, and audit trails. - Demonstrate DPDP compliance functionalities such as notices, purposes, data principal rights, grievance management, and privacy dashboards. - Explain real-world implementation scenarios and enterprise use cases. 2. Project Management & Product Development - Work closely with our development team to define product requirements and functional specifications. - Prepare user stories, acceptance criteria, product workflows, and development roadmaps. - Support sprint planning, task prioritisation, and milestone tracking. - Review developed features and validate them against business and compliance requirements. - Identify product gaps and recommend practical solutions. 3. Technical Architecture & Integration - Provide guidance on consent management platform architecture and SaaS product development. - Advise on APIs, SDKs, database integrations, website integrations, and third-party systems. - Support integration planning for cookie consent, email consent, WhatsApp consent, and enterprise applications. - Guide implementation of role-based access control, audit logging, consent evidence, and multi-tenant architecture. 4. DPDP Compliance Expertise - Understand the DPDP Act, 2023, and applicable rules and implementation requirements. - Map legal and compliance requirements to product features and technical controls. - Advise on consent notices, specific purposes, consent records, withdrawal mechanisms, and demonstrable compliance evidence. - Help ensure that product functionality aligns with applicable legal requirements. 5. Product Review & Knowledge Transfer - Conduct periodic product demonstrations and technical review sessions. - Review existing modules and identify functional or architectural gaps. - Provide actionable recommendations and implementation guidance. - Prepare technical documentation and support knowledge transfer to the internal team. Required Skills & Experience - Experience in consent management platforms, privacy technology, or data protection solutions. - Strong understanding of DPDP Act requirements and consent lifecycle management. - Experience in SaaS product development and technical project management. - Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, system integrations, and cloud-based architectures. - Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications. - Experience with platforms such as OneTrust, TrustArc, Cookiebot, Didomi, or similar solutions is preferred. - Excellent communication and demonstration skills. Expected Deliverables 1. Initial product assessment and gap analysis. 2. Detailed demonstration of consent management workflows and industry best practices. 3. Product requirements and functional specifications. 4. Technical architecture and integration recommendations. 5. Development roadmap with prioritised features and milestones. 6. Periodic product reviews and technical guidance. 7. Documentation and knowledge transfer to the development team. Engagement Model The engagement can begin with an initial paid discovery and demonstration phase, followed by ongoing part-time or milestone-based support, depending on project requirements. Interested freelancers should share: - Relevant experience in consent management or privacy compliance products. - Examples of similar products or implementations they have worked on. - Their proposed approach to product assessment and technical guidance. - Availability, hourly rate, or fixed-price proposal. Important: We are looking for a hands-on professional who can demonstrate real product workflows, provide practical technical expertise, and guide our development team—not just someone who offers theoretical consulting. To Apply: Please share your profile, relevant project experience, and proposed engagement model."

opportunities.title: ASAP 3D Grotto Layout Render
opportunities.description: I have a full set of build plans, complete with measurements, as well as an AI-generated concept image for the Christmas grotto I am constructing. What I now need is a fast, clean 3D as-built render that I can show the client before we lock in fabrication. The emphasis is on clarity, not photorealism: one well-lit camera angle (plus an overhead if you feel it helps) that lays out the exact positions of every prop, sign, and piece of furniture so the client can approve the flow and sight-lines at a glance. Key elements that must be visible • Props and decorations • Signs with their final wording in place • Cabin layout and any furniture I will forward the CAD/PDF build drawings and the AI concept the moment we start so you can drop geometry in quickly. Speed is critical. Native files plus a high-resolution PNG or JPG of the final view will be the required deliverables.

opportunities.title: HTML 3D Game Unity Port
opportunities.description: I already have a fully-playable HTML game that uses custom 3 D models, and I want the entire experience reproduced inside Unity. The goal is to keep the same gameplay, levels, and controls exactly as they are now, simply shifting the technology so I can publish on multiple stores. At the moment players interact through touch buttons and swipe gestures, so the Unity build must honour that control scheme without changes. Please begin by delivering an Android-ready build for phones and tablets; once that is confirmed we will move on to iOS and Windows PC exports. You will receive the HTML source, all 3 D assets, and art. I need you to: • Recreate every scene, UI element, and mechanic in a current LTS version of Unity • Optimise shaders, lighting, and textures for smooth mobile performance (60 fps target on mid-range devices) • Implement the existing touch control layout natively in Unity’s input system • Provide one signed, store-ready .apk plus the full, clean Unity project so I can generate iOS and PC builds later I’ll test against the original web game; acceptance is a side-by-side match for behaviour, level flow, and controls. Let me know your timeline and any questions about the asset hand-off.

opportunities.title: B2B E-commerce Growth with Meta Ads
opportunities.description: I'm seeking a skilled Meta digital marketer to work closely with me (founder) and my Shopify Gold Partner to help set up and train me to benefit from a Shopify - Meta integration. The goal is to increase repeat purchases from existing customers for my B2B e-commerce business and to grow Insta followers and enhance conversion through social media and advertising on meta. My store is powered by SHopify, and I use Instagram to raise awareness. We use Omnisend and Shopify for order automation emails and marketing automations, but the nature of it requires close customer account management. My clients are very hard to reach, so I want to use Whats App to reach them to encourage quarterly reordering and alert them on new season stock. But I also want to raise awareness and increase conversion rates for both our DTC site and B2B site with social media, influencer, affiliate and Meta ads where ROAS worthwhile. Key Objectives: - Develop and implement targeted Meta ad strategy and educate me on Zeely for future campaigns from photo and video stock. - Leverage CRM tools to identify and engage existing customers - not to replace Shopify and Omnisend's marketing automation but more to work on developing relationships with customers and importantly prompt the quarterly reorder. - Utilize data analytics to measure and optimize campaign performance and grow customer base. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in B2B e-commerce marketing. - Expertise in Meta advertising and Meta CRM Whats App systems. - Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset. - Ability to deliver detailed project proposals. Please submit your detailed project proposals. Looking forward to your submissions! I'd like to put an emphasis on teaching me as part of this work to help me know how to do this going forward.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40787978, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: GBP 750 - 1,500.

opportunities.title: Build Snowflake AI Query Automation Agent
opportunities.description: I want to have a 25 tables in snowflake under 3 different schemas with 10 in 1 schema another 10 in another schema and another 5 in 1 schema. I want have data in these 25 tables with 2 columns. Will provide additional details on the columns and how data should be. I want to have a custom claude like custom gpt to execute the queries that I give using snowfalke. and it need to generate 3 sets of queries for each custom schema based on the tables list generated in the initially executed query. I will provide the details how the queries should be. I want to have eks cluster to execute all this meaning connect to snowflake and run inital queries . Process the 3 sets of queries that were dynamically generated by custom claude and send it the snowflake and the output should be 3 excel sheets sent to the ms outlook ans as well as these should be sent to a location in the aws s3 bucket under a date folder. For this I need to build an agent technical stack: python claude snowflake aws eks

opportunities.title: Rhino Model Drawing Set
opportunities.description: I already have the building massed up in Rhino (.3dm) and now need that model translated into a complete drawing package. Your task is to place the model on its site and prepare a coordinated set that includes a site plan, ground-floor plan, first-floor plan, two sections and one isometric / perspective view. The drawings must be architectural-grade: show doors, windows, stair runs, basic furniture blocks and clear dimensions so the set is immediately presentation-ready. I will supply the Rhino file along with the site CAD underlay; if you need any other export formats (DWG, DXF) just let me know. Please return: • Vector PDFs of each sheet • The editable source files (Rhino and/or AutoCAD) - site plan - ⁠ground floor - ⁠first floor - ⁠2 sections - ⁠isometric (perspective) On auto cad and shi Because my submission deadline is fast approaching, I’d like an initial pass within 48 hours and the final version shortly after any comments. If you are comfortable working quickly with Rhino, layout tools and architectural conventions, I’m ready to start as soon as you are. THE PHOTOS I HAVE ATTACHED ARE ONLY PART OF THE ASSIGNMENT AND THEY ARE NOT BASED ON MY OWN PROJECT, BUT SMALL PIECES FROM PEOPLES PROJECTS

opportunities.title: SaaS MarTech Tracking & AI Automation
opportunities.description: # MarTech & Performance Marketing Setup for SaaS (GA4, GTM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, AI Automation) **Budget:** €800–1,500 fixed price **Timeline:** Approximately 2–3 weeks **Project type:** One-time implementation, with potential ongoing collaboration **Location:** Worldwide ## About the business We are a Spanish SaaS platform for livestock farmers. Users can register for free, connect their livestock data, receive a productivity and herd management diagnostic, and upgrade to a paid subscription. We have a public website and a separate web application, built using modern low-code/AI-assisted development tools, including Lovable. We are looking for a hands-on MarTech specialist to implement a simple, reliable, scalable marketing measurement and automation system. Our goal is to test paid customer acquisition through Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Display and retargeting, using controlled advertising budgets. ## Scope of work **1. Analytics and conversion tracking** - Audit existing Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and Meta configurations. - Configure/fix GA4 and Google Tag Manager. - Ensure attribution works across our marketing website and SaaS application. - Implement and validate consent management and Google Consent Mode v2, respecting EU privacy requirements. - Implement conversion tracking for the complete customer funnel: - Website visits by traffic source and campaign. - Clicks on "Free Diagnostic" / "Create Account". - Registration started and completed. - Livestock data connection completed. - First diagnostic completed. - Pricing or subscription checkout initiated. - Paid subscription activated. - Prefer reliable application/backend events for meaningful conversions, especially subscriptions. - Avoid duplicate conversions and unnecessary tracking of personal data. **2. Google Ads and Meta Ads** - Review or configure Google Ads and Meta Business Manager integrations. - Set up conversion actions, campaign tracking and retargeting audiences. - Prepare an initial Google Search and Meta acquisition structure. - Configure Display/retargeting where audience size and consent allow. - Recommend a simple campaign naming convention and UTM structure. - No advertising spend or campaign launch without our approval. **3. Reporting and dashboard** Build a simple Looker Studio dashboard showing: - Traffic and new users by channel. - Marketing spend, CPC and CTR. - Landing-page-to-registration conversion. - Registration-to-activation conversion. - Paid subscriptions and attributed revenue. - Cost per registration, activation and paying customer. - Funnel conversion rates by channel/campaign. **4. AI-powered marketing operations** We want the system to be easy to operate with AI tools rather than require an expensive agency. Please propose a lightweight solution using tools such as n8n, ChatGPT/OpenAI APIs, Google Ads reporting integrations or similar. Minimum requirement: - Automated weekly marketing performance report. - AI-generated insights and suggested campaign improvements. - Simple documented workflows that a junior marketing operator can maintain. - Human approval for any campaign or budget modifications. We prefer reliable, low-cost tools over complex enterprise MarTech platforms. **5. Documentation and handover** - Deliver a tracking/event specification and implementation documentation. - Test the full conversion funnel end to end. - Provide a simple operating guide. - Record a walkthrough and deliver one handover session. - All accounts, tracking assets, code/configuration and dashboards must remain under our ownership. ## Ideal candidate - Strong hands-on expertise in GA4, GTM, Google Ads and Meta Pixel/CAPI. - Experience tracking conversion funnels in SaaS or subscription businesses. - Familiarity with Lovable, SPAs, modern web applications and backend conversion tracking. - Experience with n8n and AI-powered reporting workflows. - Comfortable collaborating with our AI-assisted development workflow (Codex/Lovable) for application changes. - Able to explain technical choices clearly and avoid unnecessary complexity. ## How to apply Please include: 1. Two examples of comparable SaaS tracking or MarTech implementations. 2. Your proposed technology stack, especially for AI automation. 3. How you would track a user from ad click to paid subscription across two subdomains. 4. Your fixed-price quote, expected timeline and exclusions. 5. What you would need from our development team. Please start your proposal with **"CROTALIA TRACKING"** so we can distinguish tailored proposals from generic applications. We are not looking for social media content creation, SEO services or a large agency retainer. The priority is a working measurement, advertising and AI-assisted marketing operations system.

opportunities.title: Full KNX Home Automation Plan
opportunities.description: I am in the early construction phase of a new house and want every core system to run on KNX. The brief is straightforward: design, configure and help me bring online a single, integrated network that handles lighting and blinds, heating and air-conditioning, plus the full security layer of sensors and alarms. You will begin with a complete wiring and topology plan that my electrician can follow without guesswork. From there I need the full device list and ETS project file, followed by remote or on-site commissioning support so we can test, tweak and sign off every function. Programming should cover typical scenes (day, night, away, vacation), energy-efficient HVAC logic, and alarm responses that link to lighting and push notifications. Deliverables • KNX wiring & topology diagrams in PDF/DWG • Detailed bill of materials with exact KNX part numbers • ETS project file with all group addresses, parameters and scenes pre-programmed • Step-by-step commissioning checklist and two live support sessions (video or on-site, as agreed) • As-built documentation and a brief user guide for the homeowner Acceptance criteria: the system must pass functional tests for each controlled domain, show stable operation for 48 continuous hours, and allow future expansion through unused group addresses clearly noted in the documentation. If you have a proven track record with ETS, KNX Secure, and multi-discipline integration, I’m ready to review your proposal and timeline.

opportunities.title: Virtual Operations & Platform Assistant
opportunities.description: Summary Virtual Operations & Platform Assistant for a Music Licensing Platform Remote | Ongoing freelance opportunity We’re a growing music licensing platform looking for a proactive, organised all-rounder to help manage the day-to-day running of the business. You’ll be the central operational contact connecting customers, music partners, developers and our internal team. We need someone who takes ownership, identifies problems, follows work through to completion and suggests practical improvements. You will report to and support the Business & Operations Manager, who sets priorities, approves workflow changes and oversees business performance. You will own assigned day-to-day tasks, maintain accurate records, coordinate follow-ups and escalate issues outside agreed procedures or authority. You don’t need to be an expert in every area from day one. Your initial responsibilities will reflect your experience and our priorities, with guidance on our platform, policies and specialist workflows. You should already have strong organisational skills, sound judgement and experience managing work independently. Responsibilities Platform and catalogue management - Support day-to-day platform operations and follow up assigned issues. - Upload and manage tracks, releases, audio files, artist information, descriptions and metadata. - Check catalogue accuracy, file quality and required approvals before publication. - Maintain records of agreements, rights information and usage restrictions supplied or approved by management. - Coordinate approved catalogue corrections, replacements and removals. Licensing and Content ID administration - Process routine licensing requests using approved terms and procedures. - Maintain accurate licence records and customer usage information. - Ensure customers receive the correct files, licence documentation and usage guidance. - Coordinate allowlisting/whitelisting requests, Content ID claims and related enquiries. - Track supporting evidence, case references, deadlines and outcomes. - Escalate unclear rights questions, disputed claims and requests outside established policies. Customer support and commercial enquiries - Handle enquiries, subscriptions, refunds, cancellations and account closure requests within agreed policies. - Coordinate the resolution of account, payment, licensing and download issues. - Keep customers informed until their enquiries are resolved. - Respond to commercial enquiries, follow up leads and prepare standard proposals. - Prepare and follow up standard proposals using approved pricing and terms; refer negotiations to the Business & Operations Manager. Publisher, distributor and artist communication - Communicate with publishers, distributors, artists, producers and other music partners. - Follow up missing assets, metadata, documentation and outstanding actions. - Coordinate catalogue delivery and operational queries relating to rights and Content ID. - Prepare usage and revenue reports where required by partner agreements, with financial calculations subject to review. Website management and testing - Coordinate with our web developers, document bugs clearly and follow up fixes. - Regularly test registration, subscriptions, payments, licensing, downloads and account functionality using agreed test procedures. - Check new features and verify that reported problems have been resolved. - Suggest improvements to usability, functionality, design and automation. - Escalate urgent technical issues and obtain approval for changes involving additional spending or significant scope. Task management and meetings - Create, update and track tasks in ClickUp, following priorities, owners and deadlines agreed with the Business & Operations Manager. - Follow up outstanding actions and flag blockers early. - Arrange Google Meet calls, prepare agendas where needed and record decisions and action points. - Turn meeting outcomes into tasks and track them through to completion. Finance administration and reporting - Maintain organised records of income, invoices, receipts, expenses, payments and refunds. - Reconcile records against available transaction reports using agreed procedures and flag discrepancies. - Prepare supporting information for the accountant or finance team, including records needed for VAT returns. - Provide regular updates on sales, subscriptions, licences, customer support, Content ID cases, website issues, finances and outstanding work. This is an administrative finance responsibility. Tax treatment, filings, financial approvals and specialist accounting decisions remain with management and the accountant or finance team. Systems and general administration - Draft and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates and internal documentation, with workflow changes approved by the Business & Operations Manager. - Keep spreadsheets, documents, inboxes and business records organised. - Identify recurring problems, suggest improvements and implement agreed changes. - Learn colleagues’ responsibilities and provide cover as the team grows, while maintaining clear ownership of each area. What we’re looking for - Relevant experience in operations, platform administration, project coordination or a similarly varied role. - Strong written and spoken English. - Excellent organisation, attention to detail and dependable follow-through. - Confidence working with spreadsheets, online systems and structured records. - Professional communication with customers, partners and technical teams. - Ability to prioritise competing requests and work independently. - Willingness to handle routine administration alongside problem-solving and process improvement. - Good judgement about when to act, ask questions or escalate. - Careful handling of confidential customer, commercial and financial information. Experience with **ClickUp, subscription platforms, music licensing, Content ID, digital distribution, customer support, website testing or finance administration** would be valuable. You do not need experience in every area, but please distinguish work you have managed independently from areas where you would need training. Major legal matters, significant financial decisions, high-value deals and strategic decisions remain with management. What success looks like Customers receive timely, clear responses. Catalogue and licence records remain accurate. Claims, bugs and outstanding tasks have clear owners and follow-ups. Financial records are organised for review. Management receives reliable updates without having to chase routine work. How to apply Please include: 1. A brief summary of your relevant experience, including operations you have personally owned. 2. Which parts of this role you could manage independently from the start and which would require training. 3. An example of a problem you identified proactively and followed through to resolution. 4. The tools and platforms you have used. 5. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone and earliest start date. Please also answer this scenario: A customer reports a Content ID claim, another cannot download a licensed track, and a developer is overdue on a payment-related fix. What information would you gather, how would you prioritise the work, and how would you track each issue through to resolution?

opportunities.title: Mechanical Design Engineer: 4-color retractable pen mechanism (3D-printed prototype)
opportunities.description: I’m developing a larger-than-normal version of the classic BIC 4-colour pen and need a functional prototype for further development. The job is to take my detailed specs (spring rates, hole sizes, tolerance notes—shared after NDA) and turn them into a working mechanism that reliably locks and releases each colour. Scope • Model the full mechanism plus an outer body that lets me swap refills without dismantling the whole unit. • Produce STEP and STL files. • 3D-print the parts, assemble, and fine-tune until every push button clicks in, stays locked, and pops back smoothly. • Document the build with clear photos and a short video showing all four colours engaging and disengaging. • Optionally ship the prototype to me—let me know cost and carrier options. What I’d like to know from you 1. Examples of similar spring or push-button mechanisms you’ve designed. 2. Your in-house 3D-printer type and the materials you’d use for both housing and moving parts. 3. Separate pricing for design and for printing/testing, plus estimated turnaround. 4. Shipping availability and cost to my location (details on request). The emphasis during testing is on rock-solid lock/release action for each colour; comfort and refill access are secondary but still important. If you enjoy precision mechanical design and hands-on prototyping, I’d love to hear how you’d tackle this challenge.

opportunities.title: Dynamic Background Replacement Specialists
opportunities.description: I have a series of moving-camera shots featuring people and props that need complete background replacement. The foreground action must stay untouched while every trace of the original setting disappears, so clean masking, precise rotoscoping, and rock-solid motion tracking are critical. You’ll receive the raw clips and the new background plates; your job is to composite them so they look as though they were shot that way, matching perspective, lighting, grain, and color. Please highlight your experience doing full-scene swaps in After Effects (Rotobrush 3.0, Mocha Pro, 3D Camera Tracker, or equivalent tools). Links to before/after samples where you have replaced entire environments in moving shots will help me gauge fit. Deliverables • Final 4K (or source-resolution) renders with seamless composites • Clean matte passes for all keyed subjects • Organized After Effects project files with linked assets Edges must stay sharp without chatter, tracks must hold through the whole take, and there should be no visible spill or haloing. If this sounds routine for you, let’s talk and schedule a quick test shot.

opportunities.title: Office 2D Layout & Electrical Plan
opportunities.description: My second–floor office is roughly 310 sq ft and I already know where every workstation, chair and storage unit should go. What I still need is a clean 2-D drawing that captures: • All furniture in its final positions • Electrical information: lights, fan and AC points with their respective switches clearly marked • Two alternative spots for a compact dry pantry, each annotated with power points for a microwave, induction cook-top and kettle I can share the first-floor CAD/PDF file we used earlier; the new level follows the same column grid so you can trace walls and openings quickly. During a short Teams or Zoom call I’ll walk you through the exact second-floor footprint, confirm dimensions and answer any last questions before you start. Deliverables • Scaled 2-D plan (PDF + original DWG/AI) showing furniture, electrical points and both pantry options, each option labeled for easy comparison • A legend or brief note set so electricians know what every symbol represents • One round of minor tweaks after I review the first draft If you work in AutoCAD, Revit, Illustrator or a similar tool that lets me keep an editable file, that’s perfect. Accuracy, tidy line-work and clear labels are what matter most; the aesthetic “look” has already been decided.

opportunities.title: Multiagente Redes Sociales Integrado
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar un multiagente capaz de atender de forma automática los mensajes que llegan por WhatsApp, Instagram y Facebook Messenger. El objetivo principal es que el sistema responda de manera natural y coherente a: • Preguntas frecuentes sobre nuestros productos o servicios • Consultas relacionadas con ventas y pedidos • Solicitudes de soporte y resolución de problemas Cuando el bot no pueda resolver una consulta, deberá transferir la conversación a una persona de mi equipo sin pérdida de contexto. Busco una solución que incluya: – Integración estable con las API oficiales de los tres canales mencionados. – Motor de procesamiento de lenguaje que permita respuestas personalizadas y consistentes. – Lógica de enrutamiento inteligente para identificar cuándo derivar al equipo humano. – Panel o dashboard básico para que podamos supervisar conversaciones, añadir respuestas y actualizar flujos. Entrego la documentación de marca y las FAQ existentes; tú te encargas de configurar, entrenar y probar el modelo para que quede listo para producción. Valoraré experiencia previa con bots multicanal, WhatsApp Business API, Meta Graph API y buenas prácticas de hand-off a agentes humanos.

opportunities.title: Dạy Hệ Thống Solar BESS
opportunities.description: Tôi muốn triển khai một khóa học kỹ thuật điện chuyên sâu về hệ thống điện mặt trời kết hợp lưu trữ pin (BESS) dành cho sinh viên cao đẳng và đại học. Tôi cần một giảng viên có kiến thức vững vàng, giàu kinh nghiệm thực tế, sẵn sàng thiết kế và giảng dạy toàn bộ nội dung. Phạm vi mong đợi: • Xây dựng đề cương chi tiết: mục tiêu học tập, thời lượng từng chương, tiêu chí đánh giá. • Soạn slide, bài giảng và bài tập thực hành minh họa quy trình tính toán, chọn thiết bị, bố trí tấm PV, cấu hình bộ biến tần, BMS, an toàn tiếp địa. • Lồng ghép ví dụ thiết kế trên các công cụ phổ biến như AutoCAD Electrical, PVSyst hoặc ETAP. • Thực hiện giảng dạy trực tiếp (Zoom hoặc tương đương) hoặc ghi hình bài giảng, kèm file nguồn để tôi có thể tái dụng cho các lớp sau. • Hỗ trợ phần hỏi-đáp, chấm bài, và hiệu chỉnh tài liệu dựa trên phản hồi sinh viên trong suốt khóa học. Tiêu chí hoàn thành: 1. Đề cương và toàn bộ học liệu phải được duyệt trước khi giảng. 2. Nội dung phải bám sát thực tế thiết kế, lắp đặt và vận hành hệ Solar-BESS theo tiêu chuẩn IEC và quy định Việt Nam hiện hành. 3. Bài giảng rõ ràng, dễ theo dõi; minh họa trực quan; có bài tập cuối khóa kiểm chứng năng lực sinh viên. Nếu bạn có kinh nghiệm giảng dạy kỹ thuật điện, đặc biệt trong mảng năng lượng tái tạo và BESS, hãy gửi cho tôi bản giới thiệu ngắn gọn về kinh nghiệm, chứng chỉ và ví dụ tài liệu bạn từng xây dựng. Tôi sẽ ưu tiên người đã từng làm dự án thực tế hoặc giảng dạy cho đối tượng sinh viên kỹ thuật.

opportunities.title: Monthly Kids YouTube Animation Production
opportunities.description: I run a fast-growing children’s YouTube channel and need a reliable animator who can turn my ideas into 15 engaging videos every single month. Quality and punctuality matter just as much as creativity, because the schedule is ongoing. Most months I provide a brief—sometimes a complete script, other times just a concept—and rely on you to handle the rest: storyboards, character and background design, animation, basic SFX, and the final render. Whether you prefer Adobe Animate, After Effects, Toon Boom, Blender, or another tool, I’m flexible as long as the end result is colourful, kid-friendly, and ready for upload. Deliverables • Fifteen finished MP4 videos each month, 1920 × 1080 resolution with clean stereo audio • Editable project files and separate asset folders for archiving and localisation • Rolling schedule: 5 videos by the 10th, 5 by the 20th, 5 by month-end The channel’s style may shift—sometimes simple 2D cartoons, other times more dimensional or mixed media—so adaptability is a plus. Show me two or three links to your most relevant children’s work, tell me the software you use, and confirm you can sustain this volume long-term. I’m excited to build a long-running partnership that keeps kids smiling month after month.

opportunities.description: HOW IT SHOULD SOUND: listen to our reference read first (Klyp is pronounced "clip"): https://klyp.co.uk/hooks/clips?id=cmvpcy90g12331f&k=Fz6B_j5Hxuo0dKxzy2AMXLUf . Read the script naturally and briskly like that: no slow or dramatic delivery, clear pronunciation, a quiet room and a headset mic. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A 20-25 SECOND RECORDING OF THE SCRIPT WILL NOT BE REVIEWED. Paste a Vocaroo (vocaroo.com) or Google Drive link in your bid. Phone caller (UK clients) – leave short scripted voicemails – Philippines or Zimbabwe – remote, part-time We're Klyp, a UK company that gives small firms an AI receptionist. We need clear, confident English speakers to leave short, friendly voicemails for UK businesses after their office closes. - Hours: Monday–Friday, 18:00–21:00 UK time (Philippines 02:00–05:00, Zimbabwe 20:00–23:00), about 15 hours a week, 2-week paid trial, ongoing work if it goes well. - The job: log in to our web dialler (laptop + headset), wait for the voicemail beep, read a 20-second script naturally, click the outcome. About 50–90 voicemails an hour. No selling, no live pitching. - Pay: USD 4–7 per hour (by experience) plus a bonus for every business that calls back or signs up. - You need: a clear, neutral English accent that UK professionals find easy to understand; laptop, quiet room, reliable internet, USB headset. Call-centre or appointment-setting experience a plus. - Calls are recorded for quality and you follow UK calling rules (we train you). TO APPLY (bids without the voice note won't be read): 1. Record a voice note (Vocaroo, WhatsApp or Google Drive link) reading this exactly, then 30 seconds about yourself: "Hi, it's [your name] from Klyp. I got your voicemail, which is exactly the problem we fix. We set up AI receptionists for businesses like yours, to answer your customers' questions, qualify them and book them in, any time. Call us back on this number, 020 3870 2571, to try it, or visit klyp.co.uk, that's K-L-Y-P. Thanks." 2. Tell us: your country and city, your evening availability, your hourly rate, and your call experience in 2 lines. Process: voice note → short free practice on our system → pick → 2-week paid trial.

APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A 20-25 SECOND RECORDING OF THE SCRIPT WILL NOT BE REVIEWED. Paste a Vocaroo (vocaroo.com) or Google Drive link in your bid. Phone caller wanted - South Africa only - evenings, part-time, work from home. We are Klyp, a UK company. We need a friendly person with clear English to leave short voicemails for UK businesses after they close. The job: - Monday to Friday, 8pm to 11pm South Africa time (about 15 hours a week) - Use our website dialler on your laptop with a headset - When you hear the beep, read a short 20-second message, then click a button - No selling and no hard calls Pay: USD 8 to 12 an hour, plus a bonus when a business calls back. 2-week paid trial first, then ongoing work. You need: - Clear English that UK people find easy to understand - Laptop, USB headset, quiet room and good internet - Call centre or phone work is a plus How to apply (we only read applications with a voice note): 1. Record yourself reading this message (Vocaroo or WhatsApp voice note link), then say 30 seconds about you: "Hi, it's [your name] from Klyp. I got your voicemail, which is exactly the problem we fix. opportunities.title: Metin2 | Multiplayer Geliştirme, Hata Giderme, Performans Optimizasyonu ve Yük Testleri
opportunities.description: PC, Android ve iOS platformları için geliştirdiğimiz, gerçek zamanlı çok oyunculu bir MMORPG projesi için deneyimli bir Senior Multiplayer / Game Developer arıyoruz. Projemiz geliştirme sürecinin ileri aşamasındadır. Temel oyun sistemlerinin büyük bölümü tamamlanmış ve 60'tan fazla fonksiyonel test senaryosu başarıyla sonuçlandırılmıştır. Sıfırdan oyun geliştirilmesini istemiyoruz. Mevcut kaynak kodlarını analiz ederek multiplayer sistemini tamamlayabilecek, bütün kritik hataları giderebilecek, mobil ve sunucu performansını optimize edebilecek ve oyunumuzu ticari lansmana hazırlayabilecek bir geliştirici arıyoruz. Aradığımız kişinin geliştirme, hata giderme, optimizasyon ve test süreçlerinin tamamını üstlenebilmesi gerekmektedir. 1. Multiplayer Geliştirme Mevcut multiplayer mimarisinin incelenmesi, tamamlanması ve iyileştirilmesi. Client-server iletişiminin ve gerçek zamanlı senkronizasyonun optimize edilmesi. Oyuncu hareketleri, savaşlar, animasyonlar, yetenekler ve etkileşimlerin senkronizasyonu. Ağ trafiği, paket işleme, gecikme ve bant genişliği optimizasyonu. Multiplayer hatalarının, bağlantı kopmalarının ve senkronizasyon sorunlarının giderilmesi. Güvenilir yeniden bağlanma mekanizmalarının geliştirilmesi. PC ve mobil istemcilerin aynı multiplayer altyapısıyla sorunsuz çalışmasının sağlanması. Sunucu taraflı doğrulama, güvenlik ve eşzamanlı işlem problemlerinin çözülmesi. 2. Bug Fixing ve Sistem Kararlılığı Mevcut projenin kapsamlı şekilde incelenmesi, hataların belirlenmesi ve giderilmesi beklenmektedir. Oynanış, multiplayer ve sunucu kaynaklı hataların düzeltilmesi. Crash, donma, bellek sızıntısı ve performans problemlerinin giderilmesi. Envanter, karakter, ekipman, ticaret ve oyun içi sistemlerin kontrol edilmesi. Veritabanı kayıt ve senkronizasyon problemlerinin çözülmesi. Item duplication, veri kaybı ve işlem tutarsızlıklarının engellenmesi. PvP, PvE, NPC, yetenek ve karakter gelişimi sistemlerinin test edilmesi. Mevcut 60+ test senaryosunun kontrol edilmesi ve gerekli regresyon testlerinin uygulanması. Tespit edilen hatalar kayıt altına alınmalı, önceliklendirilmeli, giderilmeli ve yeniden test edilmelidir. 3. Mobil ve PC Optimizasyonu Oyunumuzun Android, iOS ve PC platformlarında yüksek performansla ve düşük kaynak tüketimiyle çalışması hedeflenmektedir. CPU, GPU ve RAM kullanımının analiz edilmesi. Rendering, animasyon, efekt ve oyun varlıklarının optimize edilmesi. FPS düşüşlerinin, takılmaların ve bellek sorunlarının giderilmesi. Mobil cihazlarda multiplayer performansının artırılması. Harita yükleme, geçiş ve oyun açılış sürelerinin iyileştirilmesi. Dokunmatik kontrollerin tepki süresinin optimize edilmesi. Farklı donanım seviyelerindeki Android ve iOS cihazlarda performans testleri yapılması. Yoğun oyuncu ortamlarında mobil performansın korunması. 4. Sunucu Performansı ve Ölçeklenebilirlik En önemli hedeflerimizden biri, yüksek eşzamanlı oyuncu sayısına dayanıklı bir sunucu altyapısı oluşturmaktır. Beklentilerimiz: Mevcut sunucu mimarisinin teknik analizi. CPU, RAM, ağ ve veritabanı darboğazlarının tespiti. Sunucu kaynak tüketiminin ve bağlantı yönetiminin optimize edilmesi. Kalabalık haritaların, yoğun PvP savaşlarının ve NPC işlemlerinin optimize edilmesi. Veritabanı sorgularının ve eşzamanlı işlemlerin iyileştirilmesi. Ticaret, envanter ve oyun ekonomisi sistemlerinin güvenilirliğinin sağlanması. Performans izleme, loglama ve hata analiz altyapısının kurulması. Sunucunun daha yüksek oyuncu sayılarına ölçeklenebilmesi için gerekli geliştirmelerin yapılması. 5. Otomatik Yük Testleri ve Stres Testleri Bu bölüm projemiz için kritik bir gereksinimdir. Yalnızca fonksiyonel testler değil, gerçek oyuncu davranışlarını simüle eden kapsamlı yük ve stres testleri yapılmasını istiyoruz. Geliştiricinin otomatik bir multiplayer test sistemi oluşturması beklenmektedir. Test hedefleri: 500 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. 1.000 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. 2.000 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. Altyapının elverdiği ölçüde 3.000–5.000 oyuncuya kadar kademeli stres testleri. Test botları yalnızca sunucuya bağlanmamalı; gerçek oyuncu işlemlerini de simüle etmelidir. Örnek işlemler: Oyuna giriş, çıkış ve yeniden bağlanma. Haritalar arası hareket. Canavar kesme ve PvP savaşları. Yetenek kullanımı ve NPC etkileşimleri. Envanter ve eşya işlemleri. Oyuncular arası ticaret. Pazar açma, ürün listeleme ve satın alma. Eşya geliştirme ve oyun içi ekonomi işlemleri. Uzun süreli dayanıklılık testleri de yapılmalıdır. Özellikle bellek sızıntıları, sunucu çökmeleri, gecikmeler ve veritabanı tutarsızlıkları kontrol edilmelidir. Testlerin sonunda CPU/RAM kullanımı, gecikme süreleri, hata oranları, bağlantı kopmaları ve sunucu kararlılığını gösteren raporlar hazırlanmalıdır. Amacımız yalnızca binlerce bağlantı kurmak değil, yoğun oyuncu trafiği altında gerçek oynanışın sorunsuz devam ettiğini doğrulamaktır. 6. Güvenlik ve Oyun Ekonomisi Oyunumuzda sanal para, oyuncular arası ticaret, pazar ve oyun içi mağaza sistemleri bulunmaktadır. Bu nedenle aşağıdaki alanların detaylı şekilde test edilmesini istiyoruz: Item duplication açıklarının önlenmesi. Eşzamanlı alım satım işlemlerinin güvenli yönetimi. Envanter ve veritabanı tutarlılığı. Oyun içi para bakiyelerinin doğru hesaplanması. Bağlantı kopması ve sunucu kesintisi sırasında veri kaybının önlenmesi. Yetkisiz eşya veya para oluşturulmasının engellenmesi. İşlem kayıtlarının tutulması ve güvenilirliğinin sağlanması. 7. Test ve Nihai Teslimat Geliştiriciden aşağıdaki çıktıların teslim edilmesi beklenmektedir: Teknik analiz ve geliştirme planı. Tamamlanmış ve kararlı multiplayer sistemi. Kritik ve yüksek öncelikli hataların giderilmesi. Optimize edilmiş mobil istemci ve sunucu altyapısı. Otomatik yük testi araçları ve kaynak kodları. Fonksiyonel, entegrasyon, regresyon ve stres testi sonuçları. Performans ölçümleri ve optimizasyon raporları. Güncel kaynak kodları ve teknik dokümantasyon. Lansman öncesi son sistem kontrolü ve üretim ortamına geçiş desteği. Tüm geliştirmeler şirketimizin kontrolündeki özel kaynak kodu deposunda yürütülecek ve geliştirilen kodlar, test araçları ve dokümantasyon eksiksiz teslim edilecektir. 8. Aranan Deneyim Multiplayer ve MMORPG geliştirme tecrübesi. Gerçek zamanlı client-server ağ mimarisi. Yüksek oyuncu sayılı oyun sunucularının optimizasyonu. Android ve iOS oyun performans optimizasyonu. Mevcut kod altyapılarında hata giderme ve geliştirme. Veritabanı ve eşzamanlı işlem yönetimi. Otomatik yük ve stres testi geliştirme. Ticari oyunların lansman ve üretim süreçlerinde deneyim. Daha önce ticari olarak yayımlanmış MMORPG veya büyük ölçekli multiplayer projelerde çalışmış adaylar öncelikli değerlendirilecektir. 9. Çalışma Şekli Projenin kalan teknik süreçlerini uçtan uca üstlenebilecek, bağımsız çalışabilen ve sorunlara kalıcı çözümler üretebilen kıdemli bir geliştirici arıyoruz. Düzenli iletişim, temiz kod, performans iyileştirmelerinin ölçülebilir olması ve eksiksiz teknik teslimat bizim için önemlidir. Başarılı iş birliği sonrasında uzun vadeli geliştirme, bakım ve teknik destek çalışmaları için devam etme imkânı bulunmaktadır. Projenin detayları ve kaynak kodları yalnızca ön değerlendirmeyi geçen adaylarla, gerekli gizlilik anlaşmaları sonrasında paylaşılacaktır. 10. Başvuru İçin Lütfen teklifinizde aşağıdaki bilgileri paylaşınız: Daha önce çalıştığınız MMORPG veya multiplayer projeleri. Yüksek eşzamanlı oyuncu kapasitesindeki tecrübeleriniz. Geliştirdiğiniz otomatik yük testi veya bot sistemleri. Android/iOS optimizasyon deneyiminiz. Mevcut bir MMORPG projesini tamamlamak için önerdiğiniz teknik yaklaşım. Çalışmaya uygunluk durumunuz ve ücret beklentiniz. Yalnızca multiplayer, sunucu optimizasyonu ve ileri düzey oyun geliştirme alanlarında gerçek deneyimi bulunan adayların başvurmasını rica ediyoruz. Hedefimiz, mevcut MMORPG projemizi ticari lansman için kararlı, yüksek performanslı, güvenilir ve profesyonel şekilde test edilmiş bir oyun haline getirmektir.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "PC, Android ve iOS platformları için geliştirdiğimiz, gerçek zamanlı çok oyunculu bir MMORPG projesi için deneyimli bir Senior Multiplayer / Game Developer arıyoruz. Sıfırdan oyun geliştirilmesini istemiyoruz. Mevcut kaynak kodlarını analiz ederek multiplayer sistemini tamamlayabilecek, bütün kritik hataları giderebilecek, mobil ve sunucu performansını optimize edebilecek ve oyunumuzu ticari lansmana hazırlayabilecek bir geliştirici arıyoruz. Aradığımız kişinin geliştirme, hata giderme, optimizasyon ve test süreçlerinin tamamını üstlenebilmesi gerekmektedir. 1. Multiplayer Geliştirme Mevcut multiplayer mimarisinin incelenmesi, tamamlanması ve iyileştirilmesi. Client-server iletişiminin ve gerçek zamanlı senkronizasyonun optimize edilmesi. Oyuncu hareketleri, savaşlar, animasyonlar, yetenekler ve etkileşimlerin senkronizasyonu. Ağ trafiği, paket işleme, gecikme ve bant genişliği optimizasyonu. Multiplayer hatalarının, bağlantı kopmalarının ve senkronizasyon sorunlarının giderilmesi. Güvenilir yeniden bağlanma mekanizmalarının geliştirilmesi. PC ve mobil istemcilerin aynı multiplayer altyapısıyla sorunsuz çalışmasının sağlanması. Sunucu taraflı doğrulama, güvenlik ve eşzamanlı işlem problemlerinin çözülmesi. 2. Bug Fixing ve Sistem Kararlılığı Mevcut projenin kapsamlı şekilde incelenmesi, hataların belirlenmesi ve giderilmesi beklenmektedir. Oynanış, multiplayer ve sunucu kaynaklı hataların düzeltilmesi. Crash, donma, bellek sızıntısı ve performans problemlerinin giderilmesi. Envanter, karakter, ekipman, ticaret ve oyun içi sistemlerin kontrol edilmesi. Veritabanı kayıt ve senkronizasyon problemlerinin çözülmesi. Item duplication, veri kaybı ve işlem tutarsızlıklarının engellenmesi. PvP, PvE, NPC, yetenek ve karakter gelişimi sistemlerinin test edilmesi. Mevcut 60+ test senaryosunun kontrol edilmesi ve gerekli regresyon testlerinin uygulanması. Tespit edilen hatalar kayıt altına alınmalı, önceliklendirilmeli, giderilmeli ve yeniden test edilmelidir. 3. Mobil ve PC Optimizasyonu Oyunumuzun Android, iOS ve PC platformlarında yüksek performansla ve düşük kaynak tüketimiyle çalışması hedeflenmektedir. CPU, GPU ve RAM kullanımının analiz edilmesi. Rendering, animasyon, efekt ve oyun varlıklarının optimize edilmesi. FPS düşüşlerinin, takılmaların ve bellek sorunlarının giderilmesi. Mobil cihazlarda multiplayer performansının artırılması. Harita yükleme, geçiş ve oyun açılış sürelerinin iyileştirilmesi. Dokunmatik kontrollerin tepki süresinin optimize edilmesi. Farklı donanım seviyelerindeki Android ve iOS cihazlarda performans testleri yapılması. Yoğun oyuncu ortamlarında mobil performansın korunması. 4. Sunucu Performansı ve Ölçeklenebilirlik En önemli hedeflerimizden biri, yüksek eşzamanlı oyuncu sayısına dayanıklı bir sunucu altyapısı oluşturmaktır. Beklentilerimiz: Mevcut sunucu mimarisinin teknik analizi. CPU, RAM, ağ ve veritabanı darboğazlarının tespiti. Sunucu kaynak tüketiminin ve bağlantı yönetiminin optimize edilmesi. Kalabalık haritaların, yoğun PvP savaşlarının ve NPC işlemlerinin optimize edilmesi. Veritabanı sorgularının ve eşzamanlı işlemlerin iyileştirilmesi. Ticaret, envanter ve oyun ekonomisi sistemlerinin güvenilirliğinin sağlanması. Performans izleme, loglama ve hata analiz altyapısının kurulması. Sunucunun daha yüksek oyuncu sayılarına ölçeklenebilmesi için gerekli geliştirmelerin yapılması. 5. Otomatik Yük Testleri ve Stres Testleri Bu bölüm projemiz için kritik bir gereksinimdir. Yalnızca fonksiyonel testler değil, gerçek oyuncu davranışlarını simüle eden kapsamlı yük ve stres testleri yapılmasını istiyoruz. Geliştiricinin otomatik bir multiplayer test sistemi oluşturması beklenmektedir. Test hedefleri: 500 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. 1.000 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. 2.000 eşzamanlı sanal oyuncu. Altyapının elverdiği ölçüde 3.000–5.000 oyuncuya kadar kademeli stres testleri. Test botları yalnızca sunucuya bağlanmamalı; gerçek oyuncu işlemlerini de simüle etmelidir. Oyuncular arası ticaret. Pazar açma, ürün listeleme ve satın alma. Eşya geliştirme ve oyun içi ekonomi işlemleri. Uzun süreli dayanıklılık testleri de yapılmalıdır. opportunities.title: Part Drawing & Model Scraper
opportunities.description: I have a list of part numbers and need an automated way to pull their drawings directly from a public manufacturer website. For every part number the script must: • Locate and download the 2D drawing and the 3D model available on the product page. • Save the 2D drawing as a clean PDF and the 3D model in its native CAD format (whatever the site provides—STEP, IGES, etc.). • Store each pair of files in an organised folder structure that mirrors the part-number list so I can locate anything quickly later. The scraper should run headlessly, cope with pagination or login-free search boxes, and pause intelligently so it is not blocked. Please include basic error handling to skip parts that have no drawings and log them in a report. Deliverables 1. Well-commented source code (Python preferred, but I’m open). 2. A brief README explaining setup, required libraries, and how to point the script at a fresh CSV of part numbers. 3. Output sample showing at least three downloaded parts with correct file formats. If you’ve tackled similar scraping jobs—especially for engineering content—let me know; I’ll prioritise proven solutions.

opportunities.title: Instagram Non-Follower Unfollow Audit
opportunities.description: I have around 6,800 Instagram profiles that still sit in my “Following” list even though they do not follow me back. I want every one of those accounts removed, none kept, and it must be done directly from my account—no third-party automation or scheduling tools. Because account safety is critical, I am looking for a specialist who already understands Instagram’s current rate limits and can outline a step-by-step, risk-free rhythm (daily cap, rest periods, device/IP rotation if needed, etc.) that keeps the account clear of action blocks or bans while still moving the job along at a reasonable pace. When you respond, please include: • Your proposed timeline: how many days you need to complete all 6,800 unfollows while staying well inside Instagram’s limits. • A brief description of the safety method you will follow. • One flat rate for the entire task. Progress snapshots or a short daily tally would be appreciated so I can see the count coming down, but I do not need any extra reporting beyond that. Once the following list is fully cleaned, the job is done and the milestone can be released.

opportunities.title: Model Case IH Optum 440 FS25
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced Farming Simulator modeler to build the new Case IH Optum 440 (435 hp, 8.7 l Cursor 9, CVXDrive 4x2, world premiere at Agritechnica 2025, NOT the older Optum 270/300/340) as a 3D model for FS25. I will do the XML, scripting and mod setup myself, so I need a clean, game-ready model exported with the GIANTS exporter. Please show me previous FS mods (screenshots or in-game video) in your reply. I will provide reference photos, walkarounds and technical data. Deliverables .i3d file with .shapes file and all textures, exported with the official GIANTS I3D exporter and loading without errors in GIANTS Editor The Blender (or other) source file Textures in GIANTS format (diffuse, normal, specular), clean UV maps, reasonable polygon count with LODs Model requirements Fully separated parts with correct pivots: four wheels (front wheels steerable), steering wheel, doors, bonnet, mirrors, exhaust, lights, seat Front axle with suspension and cab as a separate group (so suspension and cab movement can be added later) Front hitch, rear hitch and PTO shafts as separate, correctly placed parts Front weight block and wheel weights as separate objects (so they can be offered as shop options) Detailed interior (armrest, display, seat, controls) as separate objects Body color parts on a separate material or mask so they can be recolored in the shop Interior parts (e.g. seat) on separate materials so I can add color configurations Light positions (headlights, work lights, rear lights), attacher points (rear, front) and a clean node hierarchy with logical names Correct real-world scale Rights 100% original work. No assets from FS games, other mods, other games or paid libraries without a license. I receive the full rights to use, change and publish the model as a free FS25 mod. Credit to you is welcome. Payment and schedule I would like to pay in stages: rough model, finished model with texture, final export and acceptance. Please state your fixed price and delivery time.

Hay negocios que necesitan más clientes, nosotros les ayudamos a conseguirlos y alguien tiene que venderlo. Ahí entras tú. Buscamos comerciales que sepan moverse, hablar con empresarios y cerrar ventas. Gente que prefiera salir a vender antes que pasarse el día hablando de vender. ¿Y qué hay para ti? Hablamos, te cuento cómo funciona y vemos si tiene sentido para los dos. *Si te interesa, escríbeme* Y si conoces a alguien que sea bueno vendiendo, pásaselo. Igual le acabas de alegrar el mes. Un saludo, *ViralBee*
